elements.documentation: During registration, the CMS determines whether the applicant is internal (already has an account) or external
All applicants are displayed, and the CMS requires confirmation of whether all requirements are met or not
Admission is communicated by the PhD committee (is there a possibility that in the future the PhD committee itself will issue the “acceptance” decision?)
Access to certificates and diplomas for PhD
Access to certificates and transcripts for doctoral candidates
Maintenance of data only possible through the doctoral office
Data maintenance only possible through office of academic affairs
Accepted PhD applicants are transferred into the CMS via the interface

Enroll doctoral candidate

elements.documentation: Create in paper form and send

Three cohorts are formed:
1. Scholarship recipients
2. Reserve list
3. Rejected applicants

1. Scholarship recipients
2. Reserve list
3. Rejected applicants
In case of moving up, they become a scholarship recipient
Information contains bank details and consents regarding information sharing with sponsors

The duration of eligibility is monitored by the system (based on, e.g., semester of study, university entrance qualification, interim examination, Bachelor’s degree completion).

For renewal, the course of study is reviewed within the previous funding period.

elements.documentation: During exmatriculation, it is checked whether the person wishes to be registered as an alumnus
Including automatic creation and transmission of the information letter for alumni members
If necessary, coordination with Dept. III-1 HR Services (for registration of former employees)

elements.name: Process 10.2: Completion of the doctoral examination procedure recorded in the system
Automatic confirmation and transmission of login credentials
Alumnus wants to be included in alumni network

Alumnus gets informed about the data change
Update data via web portal and confirms the information

Search is performed based on the reference (here reference Q = QIS settlement)

Consists of: writing data into the HÜL table, assigning a posting type, assigning a HÜL number, reading data from the HÜL table

elements.name: Update Kardex with planned lab examination
Take blood sample
elements.documentation: Has to be finished at 10am. If not, the blood sample has to be sent to the emergency lab.

elements.name: Examine blood sample
elements.documentation:
In some cases, new blood sample has to be ordered:
Problems with the examination machines
Loss of blood sample
Defective blood sample

elements.name: Transport blood sample to Lab
elements.documentation: Blood sample has to arrive at lab at 11 am.

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />

    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0ok266e" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking master data (PZK)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0hc9lsl" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data has been recorded and the new employee can record working hours.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1nmmudb" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_1gwhr3e" targetRef="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr" />

elements.documentation: Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee

The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.
Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee

Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.
Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.
Time tracking management data has been recorded and the new employee can record working hours.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_0ida1k8">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_0p9olvx" name="Ulm University" processRef="Process_1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0g7kd6c">
      <bpmn:text>Create in paper form and send</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08yo6m0" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0xzvfpo" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0g7kd6c" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fccjad">
      <bpmn:text>Three cohorts are formed:
1. Scholarship recipients
2. Reserve list
3. Rejected applicants</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_087t6rm" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1dm4nc0" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1fccjad" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0htz6al">
      <bpmn:text>1. Scholarship recipients
2. Reserve list
3. Rejected applicants</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1o8bw35" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bi8tw3" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0htz6al" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_17rpc2i">
      <bpmn:text>CMS</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1l1rkpp" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1k7gqvj" targetRef="TextAnnotation_17rpc2i" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1pw3bs4">
      <bpmn:text>In case of moving up, they become a scholarship recipient</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0csabrd" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_0x1ccsp" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1pw3bs4" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0stxife">
      <bpmn:text>Information contains bank details and consents regarding information sharing with sponsors</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1iqw2dd" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_044b9tg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0stxife" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1x8odj7">
      <bpmn:text>The duration of eligibility is monitored by the system (based on, e.g., semester of study, university entrance qualification, interim examination, Bachelor’s degree completion).

For renewal, the course of study is reviewed within the previous funding period.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1gtys0k">
      <bpmn:text>CMS</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0fu7u89" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1onkk9f" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1gtys0k" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_17el7jn" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1onkk9f" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1x8odj7" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1tdgrd4" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0qxesjr" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1gtys0k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0f8ek6w">
      <bpmn:text>Only possible in paper form</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1va5pq5" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0qxesjr" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0f8ek6w" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0sw04bz">

activities.name: Edit certificate-relevant information
activities.reason: Editing structured data (e.g., assignments, subjects) based on clear rules (e.g., adjustments to the transcript) is rule-based, requires no creativity, and involves digital data. The activity is performed by a human but can be automated with RPA.

activities.reason: Signing documents typically requires manual, physical actions (e.g., pen and paper or digital signatures by authorized personnel) and cannot be automated with RPA.

activities.name: Sign certificate, degree certificate, diploma supplement
activities.reason: Similar to the previous signing activity, this requires manual, physical, or authorized digital signing actions that cannot be automated with RPA.

activities.name: Create certifications and cover letter, store a copy in Regisafe
activities.reason: This involves generating standardized documents (certifications, cover letters) and storing them in a digital system (Regisafe), adhering to well-defined rules and structured data.

activities.name: Collect documents
activities.reason: This activity involves manual, physical collection of documents, which cannot be automated with RPA.

activities.name: Send documents by registered mail
activities.reason: Sending documents via registered mail can be automated by interacting with digital systems (e.g., mail software) to prepare and dispatch mailings based on structured data and well-defined rules.

activities.name: Conduct social anamnesis
activities.reason: Conducting a social anamnesis involves complex interpretation, creativity, and human judgment, which are not suitable for RPA automation.

activities.name: Assign room to patient
activities.reason: This activity is performed by a human using structured data (Bed occupancy plan) and well-defined rules for assigning rooms. The rules are stable, strictly enforced, and involve structured data in digital form, with predictable interactions with the bed occupancy system.

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1c4j7da">

    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1abeayw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_0e5ibx1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1c4j7da" />

activities.reason: This activity involves manual administration of medication by a nurse, which is inherently analog and requires physical interaction with patients, making it unsuitable for RPA.

activities.name: Conduct mobilisation, physiotherapy
activities.reason: Mobilisation and physiotherapy require physical interaction and human judgment, including manual assistance and interpretation of patient responses, which cannot be automated with RPA.

activities.name: Conduct weekly round
activities.reason: This activity involves structured data (Kardex) and follows well-defined, stable rules for a weekly round, with predictable interactions with digital data stores. It is performed by a human but can be automated with RPA if the data is digital and the process is consistent.

activities.name: Conduct daily round
activities.reason: The daily round uses structured data (Kardex) and follows well-defined, stable rules for data review and updates. The interactions with digital data are predictable and consistent, making it automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Treat the wound
activities.reason: Wound treatment involves manual, physical interaction with patients and requires clinical judgment, which cannot be automated with RPA.

activities.name: Remove drainages and threads
activities.reason: Removing drainages and threads requires physical manipulation and clinical decision-making, which are not automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Initiate shipment

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />

    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">

actualNamesWithIds.name: Call company
actualNamesWithIds.reason: This activity involves a human (customer) calling a company, which implies interaction with a software system (e.g., phone system or CRM) and structured data (e.g., customer records). The context suggests a predictable, rule-based interaction with software applications.

actualNamesWithIds.name: Call logistics department
actualNamesWithIds.reason: The customer calls the logistics department, which involves predictable interactions with software systems (e.g., call routing, CRM, or logistics tracking systems). The structured nature of logistics data supports automation.

actualNamesWithIds.name: Recommend forwarding to logistics
actualNamesWithIds.reason: This task involves well-defined, unambiguous rules for forwarding complaints to logistics, based on structured data (e.g., complaint type). The interaction with software systems (e.g., CRM or internal databases) is predictable and stable.

actualNamesWithIds.name: Forward call
actualNamesWithIds.reason: This task involves predictable, rule-based forwarding of calls to the appropriate department, interacting with software systems (e.g., call routing software). The rules are stable and unambiguous.

actualNamesWithIds.name: Register complaint
actualNamesWithIds.reason: This activity involves structured data entry (e.g., complaint details) into a software system, following well-defined rules. The interactions with software applications are predictable and stable.

actualNamesWithIds.name: Forward interim status
actualNamesWithIds.reason: This task involves forwarding structured data (e.g., interim status) to the appropriate party, following predictable and stable rules, and interacting with software systems.

actualNamesWithIds.name: Fill in form
actualNamesWithIds.reason: This activity involves filling out a structured form in a software system, adhering to well-defined rules and predictable interactions.

actualNamesWithIds.name: Forward evaluation
actualNamesWithIds.reason: This involves forwarding structured evaluation results to the next step, following well-defined and predictable rules.

actualNamesWithIds.name: Call customer
actualNamesWithIds.reason: This task involves calling the customer, which implies predictable interactions with software systems (e.g., CRM or call center software) and structured data.

actualNamesWithIds.name: Initiate shipment

activities.reason: This activity involves writing structured data into a CRM system based on well-defined, stable rules. The interaction with the CRM data store is predictable and digital, though it may require some human judgment for content.

activities.name: Present concept
activities.reason: Presenting a concept to a customer involves human communication and interpretation of responses, which are not automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Create customer record
activities.reason: This activity involves updating CRM and AX systems with structured data based on well-defined, stable rules. The interaction with these data stores is predictable and digital.

activities.name: Discuss further course of action
activities.reason: This activity involves human discussion and decision-making, which are not automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Receive appointment confirmation
activities.reason: The patient receives a confirmation via a digital channel (likely automated email or app notification), satisfying criteria 1, 3, 6, and 8. The confirmation process is predictable and follows a single path (criterion 9).

activities.name: Join video appointment
activities.reason: The patient joins a video call via a digital platform (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams), satisfying criteria 1, 6, and 8. The interaction is well-defined and structured.

activities.name: Start video call
activities.reason: The doctor initiates a video call using a digital system, satisfying criteria 1, 3, 6, and 8. The process is stable and predictable.

activities.name: Record diagnosis
activities.reason: The doctor records structured diagnosis data into a digital system (e.g., EHR), satisfying criteria 1, 2 (well-defined rules for diagnosis), 3 (stable process), 5 (no creativity required), 6 (structured data), and 8 (digital data).

activities.name: Create e-prescription
activities.reason: The doctor creates an e-prescription using a digital system, adhering to standardized rules (criterion 2), stable processes (criterion 3), and structured data (criterion 6). No creativity or ambiguity is involved (criterion 5).

activities.name: Send e-prescription to pharmacy
activities.reason: The e-prescription is sent digitally to the pharmacy, satisfying criteria 1, 3, 6, and 8. The process is predictable and involves structured data.

activities.name: Record appointment
activities.reason: The front desk records appointment details into a digital system (e.g., scheduling software), satisfying criteria 1, 3, 6, and 8. The process is stable and involves structured data.

activities.name: Send confirmation
activities.reason: The front desk sends a confirmation via a digital channel, satisfying criteria 1, 3, 6, 8, and 9. The process is predictable and follows a single path.

activities.name: Check prescription
activities.reason: The pharmacy checks the e-prescription against structured rules (e.g., validity, patient eligibility), satisfying criteria 1, 2 (well-defined rules), 3 (stable process), 5 (no creativity), 6 (structured data), and 8 (digital data).

activities.name: Notify ready for pickup

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1">

    </bpmn:textAnnotation>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1a756w9">
      <bpmn:text>ZEB settings (person_taa_config)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0l5z4ju" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0ok266e" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking master data (PZK)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0hc9lsl" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data has been recorded and the new employee can record working hours.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1nmmudb" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_1gwhr3e" targetRef="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr" />

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1slfacu">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_1qztjjo" processRef="Process_1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1">
      <bpmn:text>Chip cards (pgd_ze_chip)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1chaa1g" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1a756w9">
      <bpmn:text>ZEB settings (person_taa_config)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0l5z4ju" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0ok266e" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking master data (PZK)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0hc9lsl" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data has been recorded and the new employee can record working hours.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1nmmudb" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_1gwhr3e" targetRef="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

activities.name: Analysis of evaluation forms
activities.reason: This task involves structured data analysis following well-defined rules, without requiring creativity or complex interpretation.

activities.name: Confirm that evaluation results are available
activities.reason: This activity involves checking digital data availability in EvaSys, adhering to stable and unambiguous rules with predictable interactions.

activities.name: Retrieve evaluation results and clean them
activities.reason: This task involves retrieving and cleaning structured data from EvaSys, following well-defined and stable rules without exceptions.

activities.name: Acknowledges results
activities.reason: This activity involves verbal acknowledgment in a lecture, which is not automatable with RPA.

assessedActivities.name: Order raw materials
assessedActivities.reason: Ordering raw materials follows structured rules (e.g., inventory levels, supplier contracts) and involves predictable interactions with procurement systems, making it automatable with RPA.

assessedActivities.name: Creation of an order
assessedActivities.reason: Creating an order involves structured data entry and validation based on predefined rules, requiring no manual interpretation or creativity.

assessedActivities.name: Accept order
assessedActivities.reason: Accepting an order follows clear, unambiguous rules (e.g., validation of order details) and uses structured data, making it automatable with RPA.

assessedActivities.name: Production
assessedActivities.reason: Production typically involves physical processes, manual oversight, or complex operational decisions that are not automatable via RPA.

activities.name: Check order
activities.reason: This activity involves verifying order details against predefined rules (e.g., completeness, validity), which are well-defined, unambiguous, and stable. It likely uses structured data (e.g., order records) and requires no creativity or complex interpretation, making it suitable for RPA.

activities.name: Reject order
activities.reason: Rejecting an order follows clear, unambiguous rules (e.g., invalid items, incomplete data) and is likely automated via structured data checks, requiring no manual interpretation or creativity.

activities.name: Write cancellation letter
activities.reason: Writing a cancellation letter typically involves manual text generation or customization, which requires creativity or complex interpretation and is not easily automatable via RPA.

activities.name: Send cancellation via fax
activities.reason: Sending a fax is a rule-based, repetitive task involving structured data (e.g., fax number, document) and predictable interactions with fax software, making it automatable with RPA.

activities.name: Send cancellation via email
activities.reason: Sending an email follows predefined rules (e.g., recipient, subject, body template) and uses structured data, requiring no manual intervention or creativity.

activities.name: Staff deployment

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data should be recorded for a new employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0619tdw" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_199cfk1" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0ykio4b" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6">
      <bpmn:text>The “chip card” is the unique time tracking ID in ZEB. Assignment is also required even if no physical chip cards are used, for example when time tracking data is imported or when the QIS terminal is used.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_08xqino" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_06rc5y6" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1">

    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1chaa1g" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1p09aug" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1na1mc1" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1a756w9">
      <bpmn:text>ZEB settings (person_taa_config)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1sq9eqa" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0klxy94" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1a756w9" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p">
      <bpmn:text>Working time (PAZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0l5z4ju" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1fcwq7p" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0">
      <bpmn:text>QIS user role assignment (r_kollektionnutzer)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv">
      <bpmn:text>Time recorder, web time recorder and/or employee</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs">
      <bpmn:text>Based on the working time data, ZEB determines the target working hours. In the case of multiple parallel employment relationships, a person’s target working time is the sum of the target working hours from the individual contracts.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0abgn7s" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_192hz16" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1xdnwrs" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0">
      <bpmn:text>Deviating target working hours (ASZ)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0ok266e" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0hhrrc0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_01kahtr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_11k1bz0" />
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0sdi7dr" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_178uzcg" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0pui5wv" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi">
      <bpmn:text>Reasons for deviating target working hours can include, for example, restrictions on part-time work for pregnant employees.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0zdgajk" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_1bhzzu7" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0osmpmi" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k">
      <bpmn:text>Usually monthly rates</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0w1wift" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_1b04o4k" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking master data (PZK)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_0hc9lsl" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Activity_0i33k2m" targetRef="TextAnnotation_0d1vdmc" />
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr">
      <bpmn:text>Time tracking management data has been recorded and the new employee can record working hours.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_1nmmudb" associationDirection="None" sourceRef="Event_1gwhr3e" targetRef="TextAnnotation_13zq1yr" />
